review: G1 相对位移接口与近桌直线倒退能力：本地只读取证

scope.note: 仅检查当前虚拟环境 SDK 源码、已采集 proto/HMI 文件、HAL 二进制静态副本及现有配置快照。

current_snapshot.meaning: 本快照是新鲜控制器配置读回；它没有证明原生定位正在 map 7，也没有证明相对位移路径、侧向/后向保护或实物空间安全。

conclusion.summary: SDK 确实提供 move_to_relative(x,y,theta)，HAL 也有独立 HandleMoveRelative 与 MoveRelative REST 路径。因此“没有相对运动接口”不准确。现有证据只够构造字段级候选请求；单位、参考坐标系、路径形状、速度、当前模式接受条件、区域避障是否作用于此路径及停车语义都未核实，不能据此发出靠桌或倒车命令。

sdk_contract.method: move_to_relative(x, y, theta) creates the shared request, assigns only request.x/y/theta, calls send_request, and returns the raw response. It performs no unit conversion, mode selection, speed limiting, timeout, path-mode selection, or arrival wait. The request header is left at the generated default.
sdk_contract.sdk_wrapper: a2d_sdk.robot.Slam.move_to_relative simply forwards x/y/theta to SlamCore; it adds no checks.

request.header: std_msgs/Header; SDK method leaves it unset/default

response.error_code: int32 / protobuf sfixed32; the .srv does not define a numeric enum

static_observations: This is a distinct handler from HandleNavigatePose (VA 0x54f10).
The handler invokes a separate wrapper vtable slot for MoveRelative.
It loads the request float fields and supplies a constant 1.0 in the third floating-point argument; it does not visibly inspect header.frame_id or set a motion mode.

The response error_code is initialized to zero. A failed low-level boolean result enters nonzero error branches (values 1/2 appear on separate failure paths). The .srv contains no enum explaining these codes.
assembly_excerpt: 0x55230: stores error_code 2 on one failure path; 0x55244 stores 1 on another

serialized_json_fields.id: read from the HAL wrapper instance member at offset 0xA0; its live value was not read back
serialized_json_fields.x: signed integer conversion of float argument 0 using FCVTZS (truncate toward zero)
serialized_json_fields.y: signed integer conversion of float argument 1 using FCVTZS (truncate toward zero)
serialized_json_fields.z: signed integer conversion of float argument 2 using FCVTZS (truncate toward zero); the service handler supplies 1.0 in this argument slot
serialized_json_fields.theta: signed integer conversion of float argument 3 using FCVTZS (truncate toward zero)

static_addresses: 0x14dd88 loads the wrapper id member; 0x14dd94 names JSON key id
controller_wrapper.return_contract: The wrapper parses an HTTP ErrorCode and returns a boolean to HAL. The HAL service maps its wrapper result to error_code, but the result schema has no motion-complete or target-reached field. No saved live MoveRelative response sample exists.

hal_and_controller_contract.id_caution: Static MoveRelative payload takes id from a wrapper member, not from the NavigatePose request. The locally captured linkhou_chassis_config.yaml says amr_id=102, while the fresh controller snapshot reports Agv/device id 424. The exact runtime binding of that member to the current controller ID has not been proven; do not hardcode either value into a candidate body.

separate_pnc_proto.schema: outputs/navigation_contract/robot_probe/protos/pnc/RelativeMove.srv: uint64 request_id, TaskHeader header, geometry_msgs/PoseStamped target -> request_id, TaskServiceResult result
separate_pnc_proto.also_found: RelativeTranslation uses the same PoseStamped target; RelativeRotation uses QuaternionStamped plus a direction enum comment.
separate_pnc_proto.not_the_sdk_path: No local SDK/HAL wiring was found from /hal/nav/move_relative to these PNC service types. The installed SDK path uses NavigatePose_Request; do not import PoseStamped's framing or units into it.

units_frame_and_motion_semantics.units: The SDK and NavigatePose proto have no x/y/theta unit annotations. HAL converts the four relative-motion float arguments directly to integers by truncation; it does not scale metres to millimetres or radians to degrees. Absolute NavigatePose conventions cannot by themselves establish the separate MoveRelative controller endpoint's units. A fractional input such as 0.1 becomes integer 0 at the HAL boundary.
units_frame_and_motion_semantics.frame: The request carries a Header type, but the installed SDK method does not populate it. HAL reads x/y/theta fields and serializes id/x/y/z/theta without a frame field. The comment calls the endpoint relative-position movement, but does not identify base_link, map, odom, current heading, or another reference frame.
units_frame_and_motion_semantics.trajectory: The API expresses a relative pose/target. It has no line-only, reverse-only, no-yaw, curvature, or trajectory constraint. x/y/theta alone do not prove that motion stays on a straight segment, that reverse is selected, or that heading is held while translating.
units_frame_and_motion_semantics.collision_zones: The live config snapshot contains a backward strategy referencing rear range 7 (rear vision sensor 13), plus rotation ranges. This confirms configuration only; there is no local call-chain evidence that MoveRelative uses these same avoidance strategies or preserves side protection throughout its path.

mode_speed_and_stop.mode: The SDK exposes switch_nav_mode separately; AGVModeControl documents 1=manual and 2=automatic. MoveRelative has no mode parameter and the inspected HAL handler contains no explicit mode gate before calling the wrapper. The server may still reject commands based on current mode; that behavior was not established. The current controller schedule snapshot sets isCanBackward=false; its interaction with direct MoveRelative is undocumented, so treat a reverse attempt as blocked until clarified.
mode_speed_and_stop.speed: The MoveRelative SDK and REST payloads contain no speed or acceleration field. Current controller values include scheduleParam.maxSpeed=1000, maxFullVectorSpeed=20, maxEmptyVectorSpeed=20, maxCurveSpeed=200, and autoMoveParam.maxSpeed=200, but their units/enforcement on MoveRelative are not established. A historical persisted HAL config records max_linear_speed and max_angular_spped near 0.2; SetChassisConfig evidence concerns a global chassis configuration path, not a verified per-relative-move cap.
mode_speed_and_stop.return_and_completion: The response is an error_code/request-layer result only. It does not contain progress, final pose, completed, or stopped fields. A zero service error_code cannot be treated as arrival. Completion would need independent fresh position/velocity feedback and map identity checks.
mode_speed_and_stop.stop: PauseWalk is a separate endpoint and SDK call; the MoveRelative request contains no cancel token. Existing local code can request pause and confirm multiple fresh near-zero-speed samples, but there is no evidence that PauseWalk is a safety-rated stop or that it cancels this exact controller request under communication loss.

candidate_schema.sdk_method: Slam.move_to_relative(x: float, y: float, theta: float)

not_ready_for_dispatch_because: x/y/theta physical units are unknown for this endpoint; fractional values are truncated before the controller call.
Reference frame and sign convention for reverse are not identified.
The API does not constrain a straight path or specify a velocity; current isCanBackward=false may conflict with a reverse request.
The live wrapper id value is unresolved and differs potentially from the controller's id (historical amr_id=102 versus current controller id=424).
No evidence establishes whether this route consumes configured side/rear obstacle zones or how it behaves when a zone triggers.
A request response does not establish arrival or stopping; pause behavior and independent feedback must be tested for this route before relying on them.
candidate_request_contract.execution_status: Do not send this request until units, frame/sign, HAL wrapper id, mode acceptance, speed behavior, path/avoidance behavior, and independently observed stop semantics have local evidence and a supervised physical validation plan. No numeric candidate values are proposed here.

evidence.fact: Separate move_relative client uses NavigatePose request/response; method only assigns x/y/theta and returns send_request result. Installed SHA matches robot_probe/docs/slam_core.py.
Public Slam method forwards arguments without validation or conversion.
Comments label global navigate versus relative movement; request is Header+x/y/theta and response is only int32 error_code.
AST-extracted descriptor confirms float x/y/theta and int32/sfixed32 error_code; it has no original comments or units.
HAL contains distinct HandleMoveRelative and HandleNavigatePose handlers over the same NavigatePose request type.
HAL contains separate MoveToTargetPose and MoveRelative controller endpoints.

Static disassembly at Handler VA 0x55174 and wrapper VA 0x14dce4; the binary hash is 1ebf199163862611e78d5299becbb51db1147be5a862c253fc228b4ded290309. Key instruction addresses and payload fields are recorded above; the binary was not executed.
HMI exposes POST /api/AMR/MoveRelative with generic data:e; no schema or units in the captured call site.
Mode values are documented separately; prior interface review explicitly found MoveRelative units undocumented; the cited global chassis limits are separate from per-request semantics.
Fresh map-7/controller-424 configuration snapshot, backward strategy and movement fields; native runtime map remains unverified.
Historical HAL chassis config includes amr_id=102; not sufficient to resolve the live wrapper id field.
Historical persisted max linear/angular speed values are about 0.2; this file alone does not prove current MoveRelative enforcement.
A different PNC schema exists (request_id, TaskHeader, PoseStamped target), but no wiring to the installed SDK/HAL MoveRelative path was found.
